name: double-failure-hold

finding.title: When both record updates fail, the pull request stays held although its thread is resolved
finding.description: `liftHold` resolves the thread first and then updates the record. When the update and its one retry both fail, the error is swallowed, the record still says `held: true`, and the approval check keeps withholding approval until the next push rewrites the record.

checks: src/hold.ts:12 updates the record after the thread is resolved
src/hold.ts:15 swallows the error of the retry

finding.suggestedFix: Update the record before resolving the thread, or let the error of the retry reach the caller.
